head: e466450c007539a2b1e4d2951c6756ff004a2b52

source.ref: https://github.com/mudler/LocalAI/pull/4577; AACR-Bench dataset.json rows 689, 690, 691, 692, 694, 699, 703, forbid seed row 1832; hand-checked 2026-10-23 by vetter A; licence MIT confirmed from LICENSE at head; the pull request's next commit (4f9ed3af26, merged as 96f8ec0402) dropped the hostname fallback and sets the header only for an explicit tag; the completion token totals are still not summed on upstream master

rationale: Machine tag and inference timings. row-703 is required: a maintainer's review comment, true at head (run.go always calls WithMachineTag, which falls back to os.Hostname, and about 25 handlers set the header unconditionally), a new exposure the change introduces, and fixed by the author in the pull request's next commit, so origin author-fix; its range moves to the hostname fallback, with the reviewer's anchor and the main endpoints in also. row-699, imported past the cap and added here, is real: the non-streaming completion loop lost its Prompt and Completion sums, so usage is always zero; only a model's reference states it and upstream master still has it, so it stays optional until a second rater and runs confirm it. Dropped: row-690 and row-692, since timings exist only in the final result and get_formated_timings always builds an object, so at() and value() cannot throw; row-689 and row-691, a double lookup once per response is a micro-optimization the performance reviewer is told to skip; row-694, a failing hostname lookup is an environment state the change gives no sign of and would only send an empty tag, and upstream removed the fallback for another reason. Forbid: seed row 1832, whose fields are plain float64 members of a value struct and always present. Seed row 1833 is not used: it questions the header on file endpoints rather than naming a defect, and a forbid there would overlap row-703's locations.

expect.concern: With LOCALAI_MACHINE_TAG unset the machine tag defaults to the server's hostname, and the handlers send it in a LocalAI-Machine-Tag header on every response, so any API client learns the host's name without the operator opting in.

The non-streaming completion loop now adds only the timing fields to totalTokenUsage and no longer adds Prompt and Completion, so every non-streaming completion response reports zero prompt, completion and total tokens.

forbid.reason: The timing values are float64 fields of a value struct, always present and zero when the backend sends none, so there is nothing to check before copying them.
